name: MAHOU SHOJO REVENGE!
source:
Take on the role of Ophelia, a broken former magical girl on a mission of revenge: To kill the members of the Solar Squad, a sisterhood formed by 4 other magical girls that have sworn to fight evil. She will do everything in her power to right this wrong, and take down these dark magical girls no matter the cost.

But not all things are as they seem. 

Has Ophelia become the very monster she once fought?

Do the monsters that destroyed her deserve to be forgiven? 

Or will she learn to listen to the ones that she loves?

[From [url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/mahou-shojo-revenge]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演身心破碎的前魔法少女奥菲莉亚，踏上一场矢志复仇的征途：亲手猎杀“太阳战队”的全体成员——一个由另外四名发誓讨伐邪恶的魔法少女结成的姐妹同盟。为了讨回公道，她将不惜一切代价倾尽全力，彻底击垮这群黑暗的魔法少女。

然而，并非一切都如表面所见那般简单。

奥菲莉亚是否已经沦为了自己昔日讨伐的那种怪物？

那些亲手毁掉她的怪物，当真值得被原谅吗？

抑或，她终将学会倾听挚爱之人的心声？

[摘自[url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/mahou-shojo-revenge]itch.io[/url]]
